messages:
maria: FYI seeing a hard spike in GPU provision queueing in eu-west-1 since ~22:05 UTC. Lots of nodes stuck in BOOTSTRAP_WAIT. Suspect recent bastion / egress ACL change.

sam: saw that alert. any recent firewall/KMS changes rolled?

maria: ops PR that narrowed bastion egress to only our management CIDRs merged ~21:50. It may have blocked node bootstrap contacting our keystore and package mirrors.

charlie: audit-bot just flagged a gap in CloudTrail for iam:PassRole around that time. audit-bot: "Missing CloudTrail events for role-assume: 3160009800-3160009900"

maria: here's a config diff from the PR:
```diff
-  egress: 0.0.0.0/0: allow: tcp 22,443
+  egress: 10.0.0.0/8: allow: tcp 22,443
```
Nodes need outbound 443 to kms.redwood.internal and mirrors.redwood.net for bootstrap.

leo: can we confirm which endpoints failed? any FQDN or IPs in logs?

maria: from controller logs: \"failed to fetch keystore: dial tcp 10.11.12.34:443: connect: connection timed out\" and agent logs show TLS handshake timeouts to mirrors.redwood.net

rachael: that 10.11.12.34 is the keystore VIP in eu-west-1 private subnet, it should be reachable via VPC endpoint but the egress restriction might have blocked the NAT path for new ENIs.

sam: quick mitigation: open a temporary egress rule for 443 to the keystore CIDR and mirrors' IPs, or revert the PR. which is faster to approve?

charlie: security prefers minimal blast radius — add allow-list for the specific service CIDRs AND add CloudTrail logging toggles so we capture the next attempts. Also need to verify KMS decrypt retries didn't escalate.

maria: patch ready, applying now to allow 10.11.12.0/24:443 and 52.23.45.0/24:443 (mirrors).

maria: applied, restarting bootstrap controllers — watching queues.

sam: controllers show backlog shrinking, GPU queue depth down 40% in 5m.

leo: one follow-up: nodes that failed earlier might have partially registered but missing kms token. We should rotate a bootstrap token? charlie any KMS concerns?

charlie: KMS logs show decrypt failures for the node bootstrap principal between 21:50-21:56 but no successful decrypts after policy change. We should invalidate those transient tokens and force re-fetch to ensure no stale credentials.

rachael: adding runbook step to invalidate bootstrap tokens and re-run onboarding for stuck nodes. Runbook link: <https://redwood/runbooks/bootstrap-tagging>

audit-bot: CloudTrail resumed at 3160009960, events: iam:PassRole, kms:Decrypt (count: 14).

maria: thanks. action items: (1) sam/leo keep the emergency egress allow for 1h max, (2) charlie to add cloudtrail alert rule for missing iam/kms events, (3) rachael to update the config review checklist to require explicit bootstrap-host CIDR entries before tightening egress, (4) infra ticket to replay and re-onboard the 12 stuck nodes.

sam: created infra ticket INF-4821 and assigned to leo, ETA 3h.

leo: re-onboard script started, will post progress.

maria: long term: can we add a managed VPC endpoint for mirrors+keystore so bootstrap doesn't rely on NAT egress? dropping NAT paths reduces risk for this class of failure.

charlie: agree. will draft KMS/endpoint policy and run it by security. Also adding an automated pre-merge check that verifies all egress tightenings include exceptions for known platform services.

rachael: noting cost impact: temporary egress allowance will route through NAT and add ~0.02 USD/node-hour while active. estimate for 200 nodes over 1h = $4.

maria: thanks everyone. backlog cleared to normal, keeping monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup:

sam: follow-up retrospective tomorrow 11:00am, invite sent.

leo: re-onboard finished, all 12 nodes passed healthchecks at 22:31 UTC.

maria: closing thread once cloudtrail alert rule is in place.

charlie: on it, will update once rule is live.
